title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Text file uploads**: You can now upload plaintext (`.txt`) files to a Genie One conversation, in addition to the other supported file types. See [Upload a file](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#upload-a-file).
* **Streaming responses**: Genie One now streams responses in real time as they're generated, so answers appear progressively instead of loading all at the same time.
* **Download a chat**: You can now download a Genie One chat. See [Manage chats in the sidebar](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#manage-chats).
* **Personalized sample questions**: Personalized sample questions now appear beneath the search bar on the Genie One homepage.
